title: Duck Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic biryani dish made with duck and spices. This recipe combines the richness of duck with the exotic flavors of Indian cuisine.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic. Cook until onion is translucent.
Add duck breast and cook until browned on all sides.
Add biryani spice blend, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add basmati rice and cook for 2 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Fluff the biryani with a fork and serve with glazed carrots.
To make glazed carrots, heat 1 tbsp of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add 1 cup of chopped carrots and cook until tender.
Add 1 tsp of honey and cook for 1 minute.
Stir to coat carrots evenly and serve hot.
